judgment.rationale: Dock entries disappear after restart and reappear after Edit/Save. This matches the collapsed center region in #50723, where initialization could precede Loaded. PR #50755 merged a fix, and current DockControl_Loaded subscribes to CenterItems.CollectionChanged and calls UpdateCenterVisibility. The reported 0.101.2362 build may predate the code, so this is covered by existing work rather than a confirmed fixed release.
